items.text: 49ers ruled out WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and WR Deebo Samuel for Sunday vs Falcons; Shanahan confirmed Evans out.
items.why: Official ruling; Evans Achilles, Deebo hamstring; no practice.
items.implication: SF WR corps depleted; heavy TE funnel and remaining pass-catcher concentration.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets spike in scheme with WRs hurt; Purdy looks his way early/often.

items.text: Ravens officially list QB Lamar Jackson as questionable for Sunday vs Bengals (ankle). Jackson said headed in right direction; could be GTD.
items.why: Returned to practice but official Q designation; high ankle context.
items.implication: Monitor pregame; if out, Ravens offense/skill players downgraded significantly.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) listed OUT Week 7. 49ers D has inflated opposing RB production +4.4% (7th-most), recent RB catches: White 4-30-1, Holani 4-24, Harvey 10-68, Love 5-19-1. Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: Official out hamstring; no third RB on active roster initially, Bijan absorbs carries/RZ.
items.implication: Bijan true workhorse; elevated snap/carry/goal-line share vs soft DvP.
items.opportunity: Full early-down + receiving + red-zone monopoly; DvP inflation supports ceiling.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (minor calf) did not practice Friday, listed questionable; McVay says he lacked power/explosion, will work out pregame and test it.
items.why: Left Thursday practice early, no Friday practice, minor but power limited; pregame test.
items.implication: Game-time decision; if out or limited, TE/WR hierarchy shifts heavily.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Higbee primary target, then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell etc per Levitan.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet headed to IR with serious season-ending knee injury suffered Thursday night; coach Ben Johnson confirmed. Testing complete, finality reached.
items.why: Carted off Thursday, serious knee, coach confirmation of IR/season-ending.
items.implication: Primary TE role fully to Loveland; reduced 2/3-TE sets opens more WR routes.
items.opportunity: Loveland elevated target/route share; Burden route rate and YPRR upside increases.

items.text: Saquon Barkley looks set to return Week 7 vs Cowboys; Berry and Stephania Bell agree if active he goes right back into fantasy lineups. Efficient in limited games played; Dallas strong RB matchup.
items.why: Practice progress, expected available MNF; prior efficiency + matchup.
items.implication: Immediate RB1 restart if cleared; volume/role intact.
items.opportunity: Early-down/goal-line/receiving role vs favorable Dallas run D.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out RB Zach Charbonnet for Sunday night vs Chiefs despite recent PUP activation; not ready per plan.
items.why: Activated from PUP but coach confirms out; needs more work, next chance Week 8.
items.implication: SEA backfield remains committee of remaining options (Holani/Wilson etc); Price still IR.
items.opportunity: No immediate listed primary beneficiary spike; monitor committee shares.

items.text: Stephania Bell worried about inserting Breece Hall straight back; Berry disagrees—if Hall plays vs Dolphins he goes right into starting lineup.
items.why: Role/talent override rust concern in favorable MIA matchup.
items.implication: Start if active; monitor final status closely.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/routes vs soft run D.
items.conflict: Medical caution from Bell vs Berry usage confidence.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford target hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen. Prior TE target share spiked to 37% when Puka missed earlier.
items.why: Usage data from prior Puka absences + current depth chart/opportunity.
items.implication: Higbee becomes high-upside TE1/streamer if Puka inactive; TE funnel overall.
items.opportunity: TE target share and red-zone opportunity expansion for Higbee primary.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK (thank Caleb). Since Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games. Clear TE1 usage spike.
items.why: Documented target share and production with Caleb; Kmet IR removes competition.
items.opportunity: 30%+ targets, high route participation, red-zone in Bears offense.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts Sunday: he's awesome, scheme awesome, and entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo out). Ignore National TE Day narrative—it's opportunity.
items.why: WR injuries create clear target funnel to elite TE in good scheme.
items.implication: Elite TE1 ceiling this week; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Massive route/target/red-zone share expansion with WRs sidelined.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR likely reduces 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden even more route juice and opportunity.
items.why: Route % + elite efficiency; structural change from Kmet absence.
items.implication: Higher snap/route share and target upside ROS/short-term.
items.opportunity: Route rate expansion toward 80%+, YPRR leverage in more 11 personnel.

items.text: Berry Week 7 Loves (per-player): RBs Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR) for workloads + matchups; WRs AJ Brown (@CHI), DeVonta Smith (vs DAL), Tucker Kraft (@DET). Hates: RBs Josh Jacobs (@DET workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo (@HOU); WRs/TE Rome Odunze (vs NE), Josh Downs (@MIN), Travis Kelce (@SEA).
items.why: Matchup + volume reasons detailed per player; Jacobs layoff/backups concern, Odunze/Kelce tough Ds, Downs target share issues.
items.implication: Prioritize Loves in lineups; fade Hates despite name value.
items.opportunity: Warren/Hubbard/Irving big workloads friendly Ds; Brown/Smith/Kraft usage+matchup juice.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played just 21% of snaps over the last three weeks. Concerning usage trend for the rookie.
items.why: Direct snap share data last 3 weeks shows limited role.
items.implication: Hard to trust as more than deep bench/handcuff until snaps rise.
items.opportunity: Low current opportunity; monitor for any role expansion.
